albumSettings.title: Album settings
albumSettings.musicAutoplayOn: Slides autoplay, so music always starts with them — this is checked for you.
albumSettings.musicAutoplayOff: Starts music automatically (only a mute button is shown). Off, the viewer gets a play button for music instead.
albumSettings.headingSizesHint: Default px size for each Headline level. A block can override its own size.
albumSettings.textSizesHint: Default px size for each Text block preset. A block can override its own size.
albumSettings.fontsHint: A Google Font for every Headline and every Text block, album-wide.
albumSettings.colorPresetsHint: Your own palette — offered as quick-pick swatches everywhere a custom colour is chosen in the builder, so you don’t have to reopen a colour picker each time.
albumSettings.showDots: Show the page-position dots (top left) in the viewer
albumSettings.dotsHint: Blank uses the event colour for the active dot and a translucent white for the rest.
albumSettings.cssScopeHint: Applied only inside this showcase’s public viewer.
albumSettings.cssLegendIntro: The classes available to target in the public viewer:

cssLegend.viewer: The whole viewer — full-bleed background behind everything.
cssLegend.stage: Positioning wrapper around the current page (holds the 3D perspective for the Turn transition).
cssLegend.page: The page itself — background, border, and where the page transition animates.
cssLegend.block: Every block’s wrapper. Combine with a type below to target just one kind.
cssLegend.dots: The left-side page-dot column. `.sc-dot` is one dot, `.sc-dot-active` the current page’s.
cssLegend.thumbnails: The bottom thumbnail strip. `.sc-thumbnail` is one preview, `.sc-thumbnail-active` the current page’s.
